summary: PO 2020 section 7: 30 ECTS from one economics specialization (from Business Studies, Nachhaltiges Wirtschaften or Economic Behaviour and Governance), 24 ECTS integrative area (18 ECTS Wahlpflicht Integration from listed FB 15/FB 07 fields plus 6 ECTS key competencies), Höhere Mathematik IV and a research methods elective (12 ECTS), 30 ECTS from one technical specialization (civil, electrical or mechanical engineering) with an approved study plan, and the 24 ECTS thesis. Some specializations offer fewer than 30 ECTS this semester, and Baubetrieb Ergänzung modules are in a separate eCampus area that is not its own specialization.

categories.name: Key competencies
categories.note: MI2 is 6 ECTS. Counted work is additive key competencies and student engagement under the university framework, language courses, and master's courses without an economics or technical focus, including study abroad, provided they do not repeat another module.

categories.name: Research methods elective
categories.note: MM2 is 6 ECTS from the research-methods electives in the current M.Sc. Business Studies examination regulations.

categories.name: One economics specialization
categories.note: Take 30 ECTS from one specialization: FACT, Management und Marketing, Digital Business, Sustainability Management, or Economic Behaviour and Governance. The first passed exam that counts toward a track fixes that choice; FACT and Sustainability Management have no modules this semester, and Digital Business and Management und Marketing offer only 24 ECTS.

options.id: Wirtschaftswissenschaftliche Vertiefungsrichtung > Economic Behaviour and Governance

categories.name: One technical specialization
categories.note: Take 30 ECTS from one specialization in civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering; an approved study plan is required, module sizes vary, and Verkehrswegebau und Geotechnik and Energie-Umwelt-Technik are the eCampus names of Straßenbau and Energietechnik. Baubetrieb und Baumanagement offers only 18 ECTS on the Vertiefung path this semester, and the Ergänzung area (Bauabfälle und Deponien, Arbeitssicherheit im Baubetrieb, Spezialfragen der Geotechnik 1, Konstruktiver Verkehrswegebau) cannot be added to that same option because each option has one area path; whether those exams count is set by the Bauingenieurwesen PO, which is not in the source.
